Notification No. NPSC/EXAM-4/2018 dt. 22.04.2026 (Limited Departmental Examination 2022) 
 Published on : 23-04-2026 10:50 am 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-4/2018 Dated Kohima, the 22 nd April,
2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 The Examination for Limited Departmental Examination (LDE) will be held on the 6 th ,
7 th & 8 th May, 2026 respectively . 
 1. 
 Eligible candidates can download the Admission
Certificate w.e.f. 30 th 
April, 2026, 12:00 Noon. 
 2. 
 Admit Card (containing details of Routine , instructions, etc) can be accessed by entering the OTP sent to the Primary Number or
Alternative number submitted in the Application Form. The link is provided under (Limited Departmental Exam
2022 
Admit Card) in the official website https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in Upon successful verification Admit can be downloaded. 
 3. 
 In case if candidates are unable to receive OTP/ phone
number no longer in use, contact at Helpdesk number to update the phone numbers
 @ 9402988506 on workings days during
office hours 09:00 am to 04:00 pm. 
 4. 
 Candidates are instructed to furnish their Service ID or Aadhar card 
for ID proof along with the Admit Card at the time of written examination. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
